headline: Russian Missile and Drone Strikes Damage Energy Infrastructure Around Kyiv
summary: Overnight Russian missile and drone strikes hit Ukrainian energy facilities and damaged a major Dnipro River bridge in Kyiv, escalating disruption to power supplies.
why: Attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure tighten regional power grids and raise European energy security and gas market volatility.

impacts.name: Ukrainian Energy Infrastructure
impacts.why: Missile attacks damaged power generation facilities and key transport infrastructure in Kyiv.
